findings.text: A table size is encoded by subtracting one from the requested count and retaining only the low bits selected by a width argument. This yields a zero based representation where a count of one encodes as zero.

The property table base uses bit ten for shareability and bit seven for inner cacheability while outer cacheability uses bit fifty six. Masks exist for each of those three positions and the combined cacheability mask follows the inner mask. An inner shareable encoding is provided along with inner cacheability encodings for non coherent and non cacheable cases plus read allocate and write allocate combinations with write through and write back policies.

The pending table base uses bit ten for shareability and bit seven for inner cacheability while outer cacheability uses bit fifty six. Masks exist for each of those three positions and the combined cacheability mask follows the inner mask. An inner shareable encoding is provided along with inner cacheability encodings for non coherent and non cacheable cases plus read allocate and write allocate combinations with write through and write back policies.

The property identifier width uses a five bit mask. The property address field keeps bits fifty one down to twelve while the pending address field keeps bits fifty one down to sixteen. The pending base also defines a single bit flag at bit sixty two.

Group, set enable, clear enable, set pending, clear pending, set active, clear active, priority, configuration, group modifier and non secure access controls in the redistributor frame reuse the distributor offsets under redistributor names.

PLPIS occupies bit zero while VLPIS occupies bit one and DIRTY occupies bit two. DirectLPIS occupies bit three while LAST occupies bit four and RVPEID occupies bit seven. COMMON_LPI_AFF spans bits twenty five down to twenty four and AFFINITY spans bits sixty three down to thirty two.

The invalidate register encodes INTID in bits thirty one down to zero and VPEID in bits forty seven down to thirty two with a virtual flag at bit sixty three. The invalidate all form reuses the same VPEID and virtual positions. The redistributor stride is 0x20000. LPI property bytes use bit zero for ENABLED and bit one for GROUP1.

The virtual property base lives at offset 0x0070 and uses a five bit identifier width mask. Shareability sits at bit ten while inner cacheability sits at bit seven and outer cacheability sits at bit fifty six. Masks exist for each position with the combined mask following the inner mask. An inner shareable encoding is provided plus inner cacheability encodings for non coherent and non cacheable cases and for read and write allocate combinations with write through and write back.

The four point one virtual property format defines VALID at bit sixty three and ENTRY_SIZE spanning bits sixty one down to fifty nine. INDIRECT sits at bit fifty five while PAGE_SIZE spans bits fifty four down to fifty three and Z sits at bit fifty two. ADDR spans bits fifty one down to twelve and SIZE spans bits six down to zero.

The virtual pending base lives at offset 0x0078 with shareability at bit ten and inner cacheability at bit seven while outer cacheability sits at bit fifty six. Masks exist for each position with the combined mask following the inner mask. Non shareable and inner shareable encodings are provided plus inner cacheability encodings for non coherent and non cacheable cases and for read and write allocate combinations with write through and write back.

Dirty sits at bit sixty while PendingLast sits at bit sixty one and IDAI sits at bit sixty two with Valid at bit sixty three. The four point one variant defines DB at bit sixty two and VGRP0EN at bit fifty nine with VGRP1EN at bit fifty eight. VPEID spans bits fifteen down to zero.
VSGIR lives at offset 0x0080 with VPEID spanning bits fifteen down to zero. VSGIPENDR lives at offset 0x0088 with BUSY at bit thirty one and PENDING spanning bits fifteen down to zero.

CTLR sits at 0x0000 and IIDR sits at 0x0004 while TYPER sits at 0x0008 and MPIDR sits at 0x0018. CBASER sits at 0x0080 while CWRITER sits at 0x0088 and CREADR sits at 0x0090 with BASER at 0x0100. IDREGS_BASE and PIDR4 share 0xffd0 while PIDR0 sits at 0xffe0 and PIDR1 sits at 0xffe4 with PIDR2 reusing the redistributor value. CIDR0 through CIDR3 occupy 0xfff0 and 0xfff4 and 0xfff8 and 0xfffc. TRANSLATER sits at 0x10040 and SGIR sits at 0x20020 with VPEID spanning bits forty seven down to thirty two and VINTID spanning bits three down to zero.
ENABLE occupies bit zero while ImDe occupies bit one. ITS_NUMBER starts at bit four with a four bit width and QUIESCENT occupies bit thirty one.

PLPIS occupies bit zero and VLPIS occupies bit one. ITT_ENTRY_SIZE spans bits seven down to four with its shift at four. IDBITS spans bits twelve down to eight with its shift at eight while DEVBITS spans bits seventeen down to thirteen with its shift at thirteen. PTA occupies bit nineteen and HCC_SHIFT sits at twenty four.

VMOVP occupies bit thirty seven while VMAPP occupies bit forty and SVPET spans bits forty two down to forty one. Revision uses a shift at twelve with a four bit mask and product identity uses a shift at twenty four.

CBASER VALID occupies bit sixty three. Shareability sits at bit ten while inner cacheability sits at bit fifty nine and outer cacheability sits at bit fifty three. Masks exist for each position with the combined mask following the inner mask. An inner shareable encoding is provided plus inner cacheability encodings for non coherent and non cacheable cases and for read and write allocate combinations. The address field keeps bits fifty one down to twelve.

Eight base registers are supported. VALID occupies bit sixty three and INDIRECT occupies bit sixty two. Inner cacheability sits at bit fifty nine while outer cacheability sits at bit fifty three and shareability sits at bit ten. Masks exist for cacheability and shareability with the combined mask following the inner mask. An inner shareable encoding is provided plus inner cacheability encodings for allocation combinations. TYPE starts at bit fifty six and ENTRY_SIZE spans bits fifty two down to forty eight with its shift at forty eight.

Page size control starts at bit eight with distinct encodings for four and sixteen and sixty four kilobyte pages plus a mask. At most two hundred fifty six pages are allowed with a page count shift at zero. Type codes run zero through seven for none and device and virtual cpu and reserved and collection and further reserved values. Level one entries use eight bytes.

MOVI uses 0x01 while INT uses 0x03 and CLEAR uses 0x04 with SYNC at 0x05. MAPD uses 0x08 and MAPC uses 0x09 while MAPTI uses 0x0a and MAPI uses 0x0b. INV uses 0x0c with INVALL at 0x0d and MOVALL at 0x0e while DISCARD uses 0x0f.

Virtual commands set bit five of the base opcode. VINVALL follows from INVALL and VMAPP follows from MAPC while VMAPTI follows from MAPTI and VMOVI follows from MOVI with VSYNC following from SYNC. VMOVP derives from value two while VSGI derives from value three and INVDB derives from value fourteen.

MOVI unmapped interrupt uses 0x010107 and MOVI unmapped collection uses 0x010109. INT unmapped interrupt uses 0x010307 while CLEAR unmapped interrupt uses 0x010507. MAPD device out of range uses 0x010801 and MAPD table size out of range uses 0x010802. MAPC processor out of range uses 0x010902 while MAPC collection out of range uses 0x010903. MAPTI unmapped device uses 0x010a04 and MAPTI identifier out of range uses 0x010a05 with MAPTI physical identifier out of range at 0x010a06. INV unmapped interrupt uses 0x010c07 and INVALL unmapped collection uses 0x010d09. MOVALL processor out of range uses 0x010e01 while DISCARD unmapped interrupt uses 0x010f07.

EOImode sits at bit one with drop with directory and drop encodings plus a mask. CBPR sits at bit zero with a mask while PMHE sits at bit six with a mask. PRI_BITS starts at bit eight with a three bit mask and ID_BITS starts at bit eleven with a three bit mask. SEIS sits at bit fourteen with a mask while A3V sits at bit fifteen with a mask and RSS sits at bit eighteen with ExtRange at bit nineteen. PMR spans eight bits from zero with a mask while BPR0 and BPR1 each span three bits from zero with masks. IGRPEN0 and IGRPEN1 each use bit zero with masks. DIB sits at bit two while DFB sits at bit one and SRE sits at bit zero.
